title: Al Jazeera: Ethiopia on Verge of Another Full-Scale Civil War as Fighting Erupts in Tigray
detail: Al Jazeera published an analysis on Sep 26, 2026 warning that Ethiopia may be on the verge of another full-scale civil war as new fighting erupts in Tigray. International observers are calling for urgent de-escalation amid renewed clashes between ENDF and TPLF forces. The analysis draws parallels to the 2020–2022 Tigray War and highlights the breakdown of the November 2022 Pretoria peace agreement, the telecom blackout across Tigray, and the resumption of large-scale military operations on multiple fronts.

media.caption: Fighting erupts in Tigray amid warnings Ethiopia may be on the verge of another full-scale civil war
